details:
ASTRONX – Interactive Space Mission Simulator

ASTRONX is an interactive, web-based space mission simulator that allows users to experience the role of a space mission engineer. It combines space science, 3D visualization, and gaming to make space exploration engaging and educational.

Users can design spacecraft, manage fuel and resources, calculate mission costs, configure payloads, and plan missions to destinations such as the Moon and Mars. From spacecraft preparation and launch to travelling through space, every decision influences the mission outcome.

Key Benefits:

- Promotes interest in astronomy and aerospace engineering.

- Develops critical thinking and problem-solving skills.

- Makes complex space concepts easier to understand through gameplay.

- Provides an immersive learning experience for students and space enthusiasts.

Technology Stack:

HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Three.js, and WebGL. AI-assisted development tools, including Google Antigravity and GLM-5.3, supported coding, problem-solving, and implementation.

Innovation:

ASTRONX transforms theoretical space science into an interactive experience where users actively design, launch, and explore space missions, inspiring the next generation of space explorers and engineers.
